GEO600 and the first direct detection of gravitational waves

In February 2016, the international network of gravitational-wave detectors announced the first direct observation of gravitational waves from a binary black hole merger. The signal had been found by the two @LIGO@scicomm.xyz detectors.

The high sensitivity of the @LIGO@scicomm.xyz detectors was based on many technologies developed and tested at GEO600: powerful and pure lasers developed at the @mpi_grav in Hannover together with the Laser Zentrum Hannover, monolithic mirror suspensions, and power and signal recycling.
